t: Al ezeh hotzaa chayyab min hattora
s: Al ezeh hotzaa chayyab min hattora, ubo y' seipim: min hattora eno chayyab ella kesheoqer chepetz mereshut hayyachid umannicho birshut harabbim o lehepek. Abal haomed beachat mishte reshuyyot ellu upashat yado lirshut hashsheniyya vechepetz beyado, unetalo mimmennu chabero haomed sham, shezzeh aqar mereshut zo vezeh hinniach birshut hashsheniyya — shenehem peturim, shenneemar "meam haaretz baasota" — haoseh et kullah velo haoseh et miqtzatah; yachid veasa otah — chayyab, shenayim veasu otah — peturin. Abal asurim laasot ken middibre soperim, gezera shemma yabou kol echad veechad mehem laasot melaka shelema beshabbat:

Haya omed beachat mishte hareshuyyot upashat yado lirshut chabero, venatal hachepetz miyyado vehotzi lirshut sheomed bo — apillu lo hinnicho baaretz, hoil vehu munnach beyado hare hu kemunnach baaretz, shehayyad nigreret achar haggup vehaggup hu omed baaretz (vaapillu im hu omed birshut harabbim, veyado shehachepetz betokah hi lemala mi' tepachim, shehu meqom petur — hare zeh chayyab, shekken haya massa bene qehat, shehayu noseim haaron al kitpehem, vehaya haaron kullo lemala mi' tepachim mehaaretz):

Abal zeh shennittal hachepetz mimmennu — patur umuttar mishshum issur shabbat, shehare lo asa kelum, abal asur min hattora mishshum shemmakshil et chabero venoten lo chepetz lehotzio mereshut lirshut, veober al "lipne ivver lo titten mikshol". Veim hachepetz haya munnach beinyan sheap im lo haya noteno lo haya yakol littelo beatzmo — eno ober al "lipne ivver" min hattora. Abal middibre soperim asur litteno lo apillu hu nokri, vaapillu bekarmelit, kemo shennitbaer besimman shk"h mittaam shennitbaer sham. Ubeyisrael yesh od issur middibre soperim, mippene shemmesayyea leobere abera. Velaken asur lehoshit lemumarim debar issur apillu yakol hammumar littelo beatzmo:

Veken asur lehashil keli melaka beshabbat leyisrael hechashud laasot melaka beshabbat, apillu hu keli hammatzuy lo lishol bemaqom acher. Veim yesh litlot sheyyaaseh bo meleket hetter — muttar lehashilo im hu keli hammatzuy, abal im eno matzuy — asur lehashilo lo ella im ken yesh bo mishshum darke shalom. Abal im en litlot sheyyaaseh bo meleket hetter — asur lehashilo lo apillu bemaqom sheyyesh bo mishshum darke shalom. Veken mi sheoseq bimleket issur, asur lomar lo "titzlach melakteka", ap al pi shedderek eretz lomar ken lekol oseq bimlaka vaapillu leakku"m, mishshum darke shalom, mikkol maqom leyisrael asur, mishshum shemmachaziq yede obere abera:

Kesheppashat yado lirshut sheniyya vechepetz beyado, vehinniach beyad chabero haomed sham — hu chayyab, sheasa aqira vehannacha, vachabero patur umuttar mishshum issur shabbat, veasur middibre soperim apillu bekarmelit, mishshum shemmesayyea leobere abera:

Veim hu omed birshut hayyachid vachabero birshut harabbim, vehinniach hachepetz beyad chabero, vehi geboha lemala measara, shehu meqom petur — shenehem peturim, sheap shellegabbe chabero atzmo en yad shello nechshebet lo meqom petur, lepi shennigreret achar gupo haomed al qarqa reshut harabbim, kemo shennitbaer, mikkol maqom legabbe adam acher gam gupo hu meqom petur lemala measara. Abal mikkol maqom asurim laasot ken middibre soperim, ella im ken chabero molik hachepetz derek mala measara, umannicho bimqom petur haggaboah lemala measara. Abal im mannicho baaretz — hare naaset al yede shenehem hotzaa mereshut hayyachid lirshut harabbim derek meqom petur, veyesh bezeh issur middibre soperim apillu bekarmelit, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shm"v. Vaapillu im mannicho bimqom petur shehu lematta measara — hare naaseh al yede shenehem tiltul mereshut hayyachid limqom petur derek avir reshut harabbim, veepshar sheyyesh bezeh gam ken issur shel dibrehem, kemo bimtaltel mereshut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid derek avir reshut harabbim, kemo sheyyitbaer. Veim molikim derek mala measara leezo reshut hayyachid — hare zeh chayyab min hattora, shehare legabbe atzmo en yado nechshebet lo meqom petur, shehi nigreret achar gupo, ukesheaqar gupo laleket, hare aqar hachepetz mereshut harabbim vehinnicho achar kak birshut hayyachid. Veyesh omerim sheggam legabbe acherim en yado o shear gupo nechshabim meqom petur, kemo sheen nechshabim legabbe atzmo, veken shear baale chayyim enam meqom petur, apillu hem gebohim measara, ella hare hem keqarqa reshut harabbim shehem omedim aleha. Veken im omedim al gabbe dabar shehu karmelit birshut harabbim, o bekarmelit mammash — hare hem karmelit, apillu hem gebohim harbeh. Abal im omedim al gabbe dabar shehu meqom petur — hem meqom petur ledibre hakkol:

Haomed bipnim upashat yadayv o echad mishshear ebarayv lachutz, apillu hen lematta measara — hen meqom petur ledibre hakkol apillu legabbe oto haadam atzmo, leinyan shemmuttar lo lehaknis letok yado chepetz hammunnach birshut harabbim, sheen yado nigreret achar gupo lihyot reshut hayyachid kamohu, hoil vehen birshuyyot muchlaqot, vegam eno kirshut harabbim shehi betokah, hoil vaaguda begupo haomed birshut hayyachid. Lepikak hu meqom petur. (Umah sheasur lo, vaapillu leacher, litten chepetz leyado mereshut harabbim sheyyaknisennu lirshut hayyachid, ap al pi shemmaknis mimmeqom petur lirshut hayyachid — issur zeh hu mishshum gezera shemma yabo laasot beatzmo aqira mereshut harabbim vehannacha birshut hayyachid, sheasur middibre soperim ligrom haknasa mereshut harabbim lirshut hayyachid apillu derek meqom petur, kemo shennitbaer besimman shm"v). Abal im hotzi chepetz beyado mereshut hayyachid, apillu im nacha yado techilla baavir reshut harabbim — en zo chashuba hannacha bimqom petur, veim achar kak hinniach hachepetz birshut harabbim — chayyab, lepi shehannacha al hayyad enah chashuba hannacha ella lechepetz shehunnach aleha mimmaqom acher, abal chepetz shehaya aleha battechilla birshut zo vehoshitah lirshut b', kevan sheen hoshata zo chashuba kan hannacha layyad atzmah, shehare hi teluya kan baavir — hu haddin sheenah chashuba hannacha lehachepetz shebbah. Shehoshatat hayyad enah doma laamidat gupo, shekkesheomed lapush — amida zo chashuba hannacha gam lehachepetz sheal gupo o sheal yado, lepi shehaggup atzmo omed venach al gabbe qarqa, mah sheen ken behoshatat yado lebaddah, shehi teluya venacha baavir. Veyesh omerim sheyyado happeshuta lirshut acheret hare hi legamre keotah reshut, im reshut hayyachid — reshut hayyachid, im reshut harabbim — reshut harabbim. Vehu haddin leechad mishshear ebarayv, ap al pi sheagudim baggup haomed birshut acheret. [Haggaha"h: umah shehapposhet yado mereshut lirshut vechepetz beyado eno chayyab ad sheyyanniach hu hachepetz al gabbe qarqa, o leyad chabero haomed sham, abal im chabero netalo mimmennu — ap hu patur, ap al pi shehachepetz munnach beyado shehi chashuba keotah reshut legamre, vahare hotzi mereshut lirshut — zehu lepi shello hayeta adayin hannacha lechepetz zeh beotah reshut, shehannachat hachepetz bayyad enah chashuba hannacha, hoil vehaya ba mittechilla, kemo shennitbaer]. Lepikak im shilshel yado lematta mig' tepachim samuk laaretz beotah reshut shehiknisah lesham, ben shehi reshut hayyachid ben shehi reshut harabbim — chayyab, ap al pi shello hinniach hachepetz baaretz, shekkol pachot mig' samuk laaretz hu kaaretz, ukeillu nacha yado baaretz atzmah, veyado hi keotah reshut legamre. (Uledibre hakkol im yado peshuta mereshut hayyachid lirshut harabbim lemala measara, hi meqom petur). Velaken yesh lehattir bemila beshabbat lehotzi hattinoq mereshut hayyachid lekarmelit al yede sheyyaamdu shette nashim bipnim, veachat mehen toshit yadeha lachutz lemala measara, shehen meqom petur ledibre hakkol, vehashsheniyya tittol hattinoq mibbipnim vetoshitennu lachutz, vetannichennu al yede haishsha happeshutot lachutz lemala measara, vahare zo hannacha bimqom petur, kevan shehattinoq hunnach al yadeha mimmaqom acher, veachar kak tanniach apillu hi atzmah et hattinoq al yede ishsha acheret haomedet bachutz, shehen gam ken lemala measara, sheyyesh omerim shehen meqom petur legabbe adam acher, kemo shennitbaer lemala, veyesh lismok al dibrehem lehaqel beinyan zeh bekarmelit sheissuro middibre soperim, shebbedibre soperim hallek achar hammeqel, veod kevan sheyyesh mattirin legamre letaltel mereshut hayyachid lekarmelit derek meqom petur, kemo shennitbaer besimman shm"v. (Abal haomedet bachutz lo tittol meal yede haomedet bipnim, shehare legabbe atzmah en yadeha chashubot meqom petur, ukeshennotelet hattinoq beyadeha hare zeh keillu hinnichattu baaretz, kemo shennitbaer lemala, vahare naaset kan al yede sheloshtan hotzaa mereshut hayyachid lekarmelit derek meqom petur, veyesh oserim bezeh veyesh lehachamir kedibrehem, kemo shennitbaer sham. Umishshum tzorek mitzva en mattirin shum issur qal al yede yisrael, kemo shennitbaer besimman shl"a). Veachar kak tachazor haomedet bachutz vetannichennu al yede chabertah, vachabertah al yede chabertah bepachot pachot mid' ammot, vehakkol lemala measara. Veen ligzor shemma taamod achat lapush beod hattinoq al yadeha, vahare zeh keillu hinnichattu baaretz, kemo shennitbaer lemala, lepi sheap im taaseh ken lo naaset kan ella hotzaa mereshut hayyachid lekarmelit derek meqom petur, veen lanu ligzor kol kak behotzaa zo, kevan sheyyesh mattirim otah legamre. Ukesheyyaggiu lipne chatzar bet hakkeneset, shehi reshut hayyachid, tachazor ishsha achat vetaamod bipnim, vetoshit yadeha lachutz lemala measara, vehaomedet bachutz tannichennu al yadeha, shehen meqom petur ledibre hakkol. Venimtza sheheebiru hattinoq mereshut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid derek meqom petur lemala measara, shehu muttar apillu lidbar hareshut im shette hareshuyyot hem shel adam echad, sheen tzarik erub kelal. Abal im hen shel shenayim vei epshar leareb — asur, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shn"g. Velaken ap kan, im en shum adam dar bachatzar bet hakkeneset — muttar al derek shennitbaer, abal im adam dar sham — hare asur lehabi lesham shum dabar mechatzer acher sheenah meorebet, vehaerub shebbebet hakkeneset eno moil kelum kesheasur letaltel bammaboy, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shs"v. Lepikak en shum hetter baolam lehabi hattinoq lebet hakkeneset al yede yisrael, vaapillu bezeh oqer vezeh manniach, kemo shennitbaer besimman shl"a. Veal issur zeh shel chatzer sheenah meorebet ameru sheheemidu chakamim dibrehem bimqom karet lidchot hammila lemachar im i epshar lehabi hassakkin al yede hannokri, lepi sheen shum taqqana lahabio al yede yisrael beli erub bemaqom shetztzarik leareb, velo keyesh mi shemmattir bezeh mishshum tzorek mitzva:

Hazzoreq mereshut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid, ureshut harabbim baemtza — patur, kevan shello hayeta hannacha birshut harabbim. Abal asur middibre soperim, gezera shemma yabo laasot hannacha birshut harabbim. Vaapillu derek karmelit asur. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bezoreq derek matta measara, abal derek mala measara, shehu meqom petur — muttar lekattechilla, al derek sheyyitbaer besimman shn"g:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Bezoreq, abal hammaabir mereshut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid derek reshut harabbim, apillu lemala measara tepachim — asur middibre soperim, shemma yaamod lapush birshut harabbim veyitchayyeb, ap al pi shehammassoy lemala mi' tepachim, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Vaapillu derek karmelit asur. Veken asur middibre soperim lehaabir o lizroq mikkarmelit lekarmelit derek reshut hayyachid:

Vekol zeh bezoreq (umaabir beraglayv). Abal haomed birshut hayyachid umoshit mereshut hayyachid zo lirshut hayyachid acheret shebbetzidda, veorek reshut harabbim mapsiq benehen — kegon ziz habbolet mehakkotel lirshut harabbim gaboah asara verachab d', shehu reshut hayyachid, veziz acher kamohu bolet betziddo, veorek reshut harabbim mapsiq benehem — ap al pi shehu lemala measara umeqom petur hu, ap al pi ken asur lehoshit mizzeh lezeh, veim hoshit — chayyab, shekkak hayeta abodat halviyyim bammishkan: shette agalot zo achar zo birshut harabbim, veorek reshut harabbim mapsiq benehem, vehayu moshitim haqqerashim mizzo lezo — abal lo hayu zoreqin otan, mippene kobdan — vehaagalot hayu reshut hayyachid, shehayu gebohot asara urechabot d'. Abal im rochab reshut harabbim mapsiq benehem, kegon sheenam zah betzad zeh bidyuta achat ella zeh keneged zeh, sheechad yotze mikkotel shebbetzad zeh shel reshut harabbim vehashsheni mikkotel shebbetzad shekkenegdo, verochab reshut harabbim benehem — hammoshit mizzeh lazeh patur, shehoshata zo lo hayeta bammishkan. Vaapillu lekattechilla muttar, al derek sheyyitbaer besimman shn"g, kevan shemmoshit derek mala measara, shehu meqom petur:
